reviewed_wikipedia_pages.finding: Five-year intervals; rounded to thousands; mixture of estimates/projections. Not used to fill missing exact survey years.

geographic_notes.CN: For retained World Bank annual sources, China excludes Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan per source metadata; Taiwan uses Wikipedia annual figures. JF 2024 denominators are transcribed separately for CN, HK, MO and TW exactly as printed, with no recombination.
geographic_notes.code_aliases: Historical survey wave 2009 uses BF/BJ where current areas.json uses HV/DY. Join on canonical_iso2, or alias both pairs. Do not treat these as different countries.
geographic_notes.unverified_boundaries: Same area code and same year does not guarantee exact correspondence between survey institutional coverage and population geographic scope. No country populations have been summed into a global denominator.

limitations: Surveyed learners per population is a coverage-normalized survey measure, not a prevalence estimate of all Japanese learners.
Midyear World Bank population and annual-average Taiwan population differ in reference basis; show source and year in tooltips/export.
Ratios involving teacher counts do not imply class sizes; teachers may work across institutions and survey counting methodology applies.
Do not fill population gaps using zero, latest-year population or interpolation. CK/NU/VA remain missing.
The retrieval snapshot is intentionally frozen; World Bank subsequently revised datasets may differ from this download.

JF 2024 denominators have varying or unspecified underlying reference dates. Population ratio trends crossing into 2024 have a denominator-source break; they do not measure like-for-like population-adjusted growth.
